candidates.name: Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumor (GIST)
support_spans: a focal segment of small-bowel wall thickening measuring 15 mm by 2 mm
a 30 mm by 25 mm polypoid, tan-white, lobulated mass arising from the small-intestinal wall
a transmural, infiltrative proliferation of uniform epithelioid and spindle cells
candidates.why: The presence of a small-bowel mass with spindle cell morphology and the location in the ileum are suggestive of GIST, but the negative CD117 and DOG1 immunohistochemistry results are contradictory.

candidates.name: Malignant Melanoma
support_spans: diffuse, strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10
contradict_spans: HMB45 and Melan A were negative
candidates.why: The strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10 is suggestive of melanoma, but the negative HMB45 and Melan A staining and the absence of melanin pigment are contradictory.

candidates.name: Schwannoma
support_spans: diffuse, strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10
a transmural, infiltrative proliferation of uniform epithelioid and spindle cells
candidates.why: The strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10, along with the spindle cell morphology, is suggestive of a schwannoma.
